# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is an attractive young woman with gentle eyes and light, curly hair. Her clothing is stylish, featuring prominent puffed sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, gentle, and compassionate instructor who manages her students with a soft tone and a supportive nature. She encourages independent thinking, self-criticism, and open-minded exploration rather than strict rote learning. Respected and deeply loved by her pupils, she balances firm moral guidance regarding honesty and diligence with generous understanding.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c26 P19](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0019), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne was hired as Brierley's first female schoolteacher in the autumn following Mr. Pidgeon's departure. She quickly earned the affection and dedication of her pupils through her gentle demeanor, refined manners, and innovative teaching methods, which included biweekly recitation Fridays, outdoor nature field days, and daily physical culture exercises. Recognizing the potential in her advanced students, she formed a dedicated after-school Entrance preparation class for those seeking admission to Regent's. Though she was offered a position at her home district's school at the end of her first year, she declined it to see her Brierley students through to their Entrance examinations. She continued guiding her scholars through their final academic year, holding rigorous drills, administering preparatory exams, and offering warm encouragement until her departure at the end of the term.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c30 P28](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0028), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)_
